What the crop buys

    
Whose average
A template is the average of the faces that went into it, and it matches best the faces that resemble that average. Changing N here changes which people the template is built from, not only how many. Every score on this page is computed in the browser with the same formula as cv.matchTemplate, and checked against OpenCV at N = 1, 10, 50 and 337.
